veranderings.blok: Die vloed was nie genoeg nie
veranderings.voor: Te min water het swak oeste gebring
veranderings.na: Te min water het swak oeste veroorsaak
veranderings.rede: 'Oeste bring' as cause echoes English 'brought poor harvests'; 'veroorsaak' is the natural Afrikaans verb for a cause and keeps the meaning (the earlier rejected 'meegebring' was for a different sentence).
